headline: Bring AiDot Wi-Fi lights into Home Assistant
intro: Connect AiDot A19 and BR30 lights after adding them to your account in the official AiDot app. Sign in with your country, username, and password; Home Assistant creates a light entity for each device.
highlights: Turn lights on or off and adjust brightness; color temperature and RGBW color depend on the device.
After sign-in, Home Assistant retrieves the device list from AiDot Cloud and checks for additions or deletions every 6 hours.
Each device keeps a persistent TCP connection for real-time status updates when its state changes.

flow.title: Connect AiDot lights
stages: Add devices to your account in the official AiDot app
Control each light and receive real-time status updates
